title: perf(app-shell): a dashboard opens from the app bundle and asks only its widgets' objects by name
body:
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKrysggasng4nRhjbWGK8uM)_ Fixes #28784 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none Claim: 6575848918 ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：打开应用里的仪表盘时，仪表盘定义直接从应用 bundle 读，不再读整张仪表盘列表；对象只读本应用包的对象列表，加上小部件 `requiresObject` 点名的对象（按名读），不再读整张对象注册表和视图表。 - 为什么改：每次打开仪表盘都要等整表对象（showcase 上 746 KB，staging 上 3.4–7.0 秒）、视图表和仪表盘列表都返回后，图表查询才发出，而 bundle 里已经有这个仪表盘。 - 风险与回滚：bundle 里没有的仪表盘（别的包的、草稿预览）照旧读列表，按本包优先；小部件依赖的对象不存在时照旧隐藏该小部件，改为按服务器的"不存在"答复判断。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`（仪表盘路由的对象范围，`readDashboardWidgetObjects` / `readDashboardObjectScope`）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView.tsx`（bundle 优先读仪表盘、按名剪枝小部件）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`（仪表盘路由不再等 `dashboard` 桶）。 - 两分钟验证：打开 showcase 的 `/apps/showcase_app/dashboard/showcase_ops_dashboard`，开发者工具 Network 过滤 `meta/`：看不到 `meta/dashboard`、`meta/view`，也看不到不带 `?package=` 的 `meta/object`；九个图表照常出数。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes On `main`, every open of `/apps/APP/dashboard/NAME` read three whole lists before its widgets could query: `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard`, the whole object registry `GET /api/v1/meta/object` (composed with `GET /api/v1/meta/view`). The route gate (`routeReads` for `dashboard/:dashboardName` is `['dashboard', 'object']`) waited for both buckets, and the dashboard route was not on the object-scope list, so the `object` bucket meant the whole registry. The app bundle already held the dashboard. | Reader | Before | Now | |---|---|---| | `DashboardView`: the dashboard | `/meta/dashboard` list, prefer-local | the bundle's, when it holds the one the app's package owns (`useBundledItem`); the list, prefer-local, only on a miss | | `DashboardView`: the widget capability gate (`requiresObject`, else `object`) | the whole registry; a name absent from it hides the widget | `readDashboardWidgetObjects`: the widgets' names, by name, beside the app's package list, without views; a name the server answers absent (`missing`) hides the widget | | `AppContent`: the route gate | waits for the `dashboard` and the whole `object` buckets | drops `dashboard` when bundle reads exist (as the page route does); the route reads the app's object scope (`dashboard/:dashboardName` joins `APP_OBJECT_SCOPE_ROUTES`) and waits only for the widgets' names, and for nothing when they name none | | `AppContent`: the chrome's objects | the whole registry | the app's scope: the package list plus, by name, the widgets' names, the app's `requiresObject` entries and the palette's objects while it is open | `readObjectsByName` was not needed: the package-plus-names scope already reads an out-of-package name by name. A hand-rolled metadata context (no `readObjectScope`) keeps the whole list, and an adapter without the bundle keeps both buckets. ## Tests - New `console/__tests__/AppContent.dashboardRouteReads-28784.test.tsx`, over the real `MetadataProvider`, `AppContent` and `DashboardView`, a client double that records each read and an app bundle the test controls: (a) a bundled dashboard opens with no `dashboard` list, no whole `object` list and no `view` list; (b) the widgets' objects are asked by name and a widget whose object is absent is left out; (c) CONTROL: a dashboard outside the bundle is read from the list, prefer-local, still without the whole object list. - Updated `console/__tests__/openPathObjectReaders-12811.test.ts`: the `DashboardView` row is now `scope`. - No existing `DashboardView*.test.tsx` pin moved. ## Acceptance notes - Expected 32 → 30 on the claim; measured 32 → 30 (see Verification). - On localhost the first dataset query moves little (the bundle, which the route still waits for, is the longer wait there); the change removes 782,598 bytes of metadata reads from the route's critical path and adds one 157,802-byte package list. On staging the comment's readings put the whole object list at 3.4 → 7.0 s. - `design/dashboard/:dashboardName` (the designer) and the `search` route still read the dashboard list; out of this card's scope. ## Verification
Dashboard requests, production Console, showcase (objectstack dev --fresh), warm reload x3 Base `96fb7b5d` (the ui sources restored to it, same box, same server build): 32 `/api/` requests (one run 33). `GET /api/v1/meta/object` 746,514 B, `GET /api/v1/meta/view` 24,009 B, `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard` 12,075 B, all after the bundle; first `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` at 1709 / 1135 / 1006 ms. This branch `ae3d70fb`: 30 requests. No `meta/dashboard`, no `meta/view`, no `meta/object` without `?package=`; `GET /api/v1/meta/object?package=com.example.showcase` 157,802 B instead. First dataset query at 1654 / 1032 / 885 ms. The nine dataset queries and every other request are the same set.
Ablations (each leg through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored with git diff HEAD empty) - A1 route gate keeps the `dashboard` bucket → (a), (b) red. - A2 `DashboardView` ignores the bundle's hit → (a), (b) red. - A3 `dashboard/:dashboardName` off `APP_OBJECT_SCOPE_ROUTES` → (a), (b), (c) red. - A4 the prune ignores `missing` → (b) red.
Local runs - 108 app-shell test files naming `DashboardView`, `appObjectScope`, `readAppObjectScope`, `AppContent`, `openPathObjectReaders`, `appRouteMetadataReads`: 108 files / 878 tests passed; the new pin 3/3. - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0. - `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed files: 0 errors. `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new. `pnpm --dir ui check:spec-symbols`: exit 0. - Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`) at `ae3d70fb`: 34 derived, 34 run, all exit 0, reconciled with `--ran` (0 NOT-MEASURED); `check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (169 files passed, 2 skipped) under the verify lock; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0 among them. The full app-shell suite is CI's Test UI.
